'''Devendra Lal''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (14 February 1929 – 1 December 2012) was an Indian [[geophysicist]].

==Life==
He was born in [[Varanasi, India]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scripps.ucsd.edu/news/obituary-notice-devendra-lal-1929-2012 |title=:: SCRIPPS OCEANOGRAPHY NEWS : : Obituary Notice: Devendra Lal: 1929-2012 :: |publisher=scripps.ucsd.edu |date= 10 January 2013|access-date=2013-05-28}}</ref> 
He graduated from [[Banaras Hindu University]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://sio.ucsd.edu/Profile/dlal |title=:: Scripps Institution Of Oceanography, Ucsd : ::: |publisher=Sio.ucsd.edu |date=2012-12-10 |access-date=2013-05-28 |archive-date=13 April 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130413014614/http://sio.ucsd.edu/Profile/dlal |url-status=dead }}</ref>
He graduated from [[Bombay University]]; his thesis was on cosmic ray physics; his thesis adviser was [[Bernard Peters]].<ref>{{Cite web|title = Devendra Lal (1929-2012)|publisher = Geochemical Society|url = http://www.geochemsoc.org/news/inmemoriam/devendra-lal-1929-2012/|website = www.geochemsoc.org|access-date = 2015-09-10|archive-date = 7 September 2015|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150907193751/http://www.geochemsoc.org/news/inmemoriam/devendra-lal-1929-2012/|url-status = dead}}</ref>

He was Director, of the Physical Research Laboratory, Ahmedabad from 1972 to 1983.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.indiajournal.com/archives/32396 |title=Geophysicist Devendra Lal Dead |publisher=India Journal |date=2012-12-15 |access-date=2013-05-28 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130629121336/http://www.indiajournal.com/archives/32396 |archive-date=29 June 2013 |df=dmy-all }}</ref>

He was Visiting Professor at Scripps Institution of Oceanography, [[University of California, San Diego]], from 1989 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://meteoriticalsociety.org/index.php?page_id=0&block_id=42&active_action=journal_view_main_detail&key=jowdjhjs9-42&post_id=59&comment_flag=1 |title=Devendra Lal, 1929-2012 |publisher=The Meteoritical Society |date=2012-10-21 |access-date=2013-05-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|author=<!-- Staff author(s); no by-line --> |url=https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/science/geophysicist-devendra-lal-passes-away/article4178634.ece |title=Geophysicist Devendra Lal passes away |newspaper=The Hindu |date=2012-12-08 |access-date=2013-05-28}}</ref>
Devendra Lal was President of the [[International Union of Geodesy and Geophysics]] (IUGG) from 1983 to 1987. He was also elected Fellow of the [[Royal Society]] in 1979.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Goswami|first1=J. N.|last2=Macdougall|first2=J. D.|date=2021|title=Devendra Lal. 14 February 1929—1 December 2012|journal=Biographical Memoirs of Fellows of the Royal Society|volume=70|pages=263–281 |doi=10.1098/rsbm.2020.0047 |doi-access=free}}</ref>
